name: Zen Leaf St. Charles
how_menu_reached: Same as every Zen Leaf store: Verano's Next.js app on the brand domain renders a Sweed-powered menu as a SPA route; no iframe and no SSR query cache. The browser downloads one whole-branch catalog from data.zenleafdispensaries.com and filters it by category route.
branch_selection: URL slug st-charles -> GET data.zenleafdispensaries.com/menu-config/st-charles returns sweedId 537 (dual menu: Medical + Recreational). Flight data sweedStores entry: id 537 'Zen Leaf St. Charles', '3691 East Main Street, St. Charles, Illinois', pin 41.9208,-88.2715 (the registry pin 41.9212,-88.3052 is about 1.7 mi away, so identity rests on the street match; addresses_match('3691 E. Main St.','3691 East Main Street') is True at HEAD).
age_gate: global-age-gate.min.js is loaded; the same site showed the menu without a click in the headless run (checked on the Aurora route)

data_loading.mechanism: REST JSON (one whole-branch document), plain curl returns 200
endpoints: GET https://zenleafdispensaries.com/ or any /locations/<slug> page: Flight data sweedStores lists all 77 chain stores (root page also carries it)
data_loading.notes: Catalog JSON {products[], filters, sorting, popularSearches}; variants carry unitSize, unitsInPackage, price, promoPrice, orderingAvailability. No advertised total.

paging: none: one document; no declared total, so grade B (two agreeing reads) via backend/providers/verano.py
license_channels: rec and med menus both exist but /catalog/537/medical == /catalog/537/recreational byte for byte. 1178 products / 1347 variants: Flower 305, Vapes 285, Edibles 180, Pre-Rolls 161, Accessories 95, Concentrates 84, Drinks 51, Apparel 7, Tinctures 7, Topicals 3.

root page https://zenleafdispensaries.com/ (200, 844 KB) also yields a 77-store sweedStores list via verano.store_list, so the new zen\s*leaf connector in locators.py can match this store by address
